title: Aurora black triangle program

tellings.quote: The Aurora had also showed up as a line item in the 1987 congressional budget with $2.3 billion earmarked for it, something Lockheed had trouble explaining away.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, citing the writer Nick Cook, tells of Aurora, said to be a secret aircraft programme linked to sightings of black triangle-shaped craft over places like Groom Lake in Nevada and the North Sea from the late 1980s into the 1990s. Michels says Aurora showed up as a line item in the 1987 congressional budget with $2.3 billion set aside, which the aerospace company Lockheed had trouble explaining. He points to Jane's Defence Weekly, a defence trade magazine, and British Ministry of Defence papers, which would suggest the US was flying secret advanced craft if true.
